status: IMPLEMENTED FOR CONTROLLED A/B; NOT DECK VERIFIED

upstream.caveat: 27/27 recorded tricks is not a first-attempt repeatability denominator.

demonstrated_differences.compiler: Same 18-tick setup, arc midpoint/interpolation, later 90-degree subdivision, release and end spacing; parser is reused unchanged.
demonstrated_differences.timeline: Current delivery schedule advances one step per observed poll and reschedules later arcs from that poll. Reference selects latest step due on an absolute game-tick timeline.
demonstrated_differences.clock: Pinned Runtime/client_tick.cpp calls style::on_client_tick, then style_editor_entry.cpp calls trick_pad::tick after the native client update. Arcade on_client_tick also runs after that native update, inside update_model and before its 500 ms model refresh gate. Neither clock is XInput poll count; Arcade additionally gates on valid client/observer state.
demonstrated_differences.packets: Current XOR of physical packet and tick can collide. Reference emits a new packet per poll, including same-tick polls.
demonstrated_differences.pad: Reference replaces the full pad while its script owns input; ordinary Arcade preserves physical controls outside its translation.
demonstrated_differences.safety: Experiment retains Arcade menu/freshness/backwards-clock/180-tick cancellation. It deliberately does not copy upstream's no-tick fallback or two-second terminal linger. Compare the active trajectory before these terminal differences.

modes.delivery: Existing schedule and packet handling, with bounded active-poll diagnostics enabled.
modes.timeline: Absolute schedule only; ordinary packet handling and masking.
modes.reference: Absolute schedule, per-poll packet progression and complete pad replacement during the active authored flip.
modes.off: Restore delivery schedule and disable extra poll diagnostics.

selection: With Arcade Mode OFF, use arcadeplayback delivery|timeline|reference|off in the existing console, then enable Arcade Mode. Selection is unsaved; startup defaults to ordinary delivery. Mode changes while enabled are rejected.
analysis: Run python3 contrib/arcade-mode/lab/playback_report.py RESULT.json on sanitized trial or batch evidence. It joins sampled cadence and stick rows, checks reference packet deltas against cumulative polls, and reports measured timing and native IDs separately from neutralization/reset. It never infers trick success from requested input. Old artifacts without new timing evidence remain incomplete.

controlled_trials.first_comparison: Reference versus delivery in paired blocks on the same installed DLL and same authored catalog; timeline arm isolates a demonstrated discrepancy.
controlled_trials.baseline: Same safe stationary location and clear-bit stance, at least 500 ms measured stable riding, identical 600 ms preparation, neutral physical LS and triggers, D-pad plus single X. Do not compare held-A setup in the first experiment.
controlled_trials.rate: Match the reference's 60 Hz simulation and normal time scale through existing local setting controls; measure tick/ms cadence and do not infer simulation rate from display refresh.
controlled_trials.evidence: Join bounded playback and delivered-stick rows by seq; retain native FlipTrickType, timestamps, poll/tick/packet progression, gaps/drops, neutralization and reset. Cadence rows sample each active game tick and every changed output; cumulative poll counts expose additional same-tick reads without logging every identical poll. Reject incomplete timing evidence rather than promoting a partial trace.
controlled_trials.acceptance: No promotion from local tests. Preserve all native misrecognitions. After selecting a proven change, at least 20 controlled trials per supported action with relevant context variation and no unexplained stuck states are required.

blocker: steamdeck.local did not resolve on paired SSH checks, including after a bounded wake request. Existing runner pins still target d0c835c despite the later recorded 6a8db43 install; re-read status and review exact target pins before any input.
